⚠️ **Seat stub.** Job description: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/qa.md` and the `checklist-test` skill §4–§6 (⛔ not copied here). This is **`qa` seat 1**.

## Current PM — ⏳ vacant

- **Previous holder:** `zhuangjianguo` · `session_01QsR2jUARzLeR7GhKms8a5s` · seated 2026-11-08, clocked out 2026-11-15T08:53Z on the maintainer's word (「你可以下班了。」). `check-handover.mjs` exited 0 (no unreleased claim, no decision outside the inbox). The seated-time body is the revision of 2026-11-09.
- **Patrol:** none (the seat runs on the maintainer's word, no routine). **Mailbox:** none was opened.
- **Takeover:** `/pm-dispatch qa`, then read this post and the comments under it.

## Standing orders (maintainer, verbatim; the comments below quote each in place)

- 「也不需要每周跑，一波开发完了，我会和你说」 and 「维持"每波开发完你通知"」: no schedule; a round starts on the maintainer's word after a development wave. Charter: #31434 (merged).
- 「纳入，本轮一起跑，立卡交 skills 车道」: each round has a scenario half (the `starter` cards, `--modes scratch --packages workspace`).
- 「qa#1 继续按口令跑例行轮，qa#2 执行发版波次」: this seat runs the routine rounds only; release waves are `qa#2`'s.
- 「可以开云卡」: runners may run as cloud sessions.

## Ledger at clock-out

- Round 1 checklist half: record #31486 (closed; 73/73 · 61 PASS / 7 PARTIAL / 4 FAIL / 1 BLOCKED). Extracted #31488, #31490–#31498, collection card #31499: all closed, fixed by merged PRs. Round 1 scenario half: round record comment 6754602020 below; extracted #31998 and #31999, both closed, fixed.
- Owed now (`retest-owed.mjs` on 2026-11-09): 11 rows, the 10 round-1 fix cards plus `studio-authoring.expression-editors` (#27482) and the blocked `access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics`. The next routine round re-judges them; open `qa-run` records: 0.
- Not carded, offered to the maintainer and unanswered (runner observations, judgment calls): a data-door PATCH of a readonly `sys_file` column answers 200 and drops the change silently; the permission matrix's field bulk "Write all" on a filter matching system columns grants them editable; the Setup audit log's Record column shows truncated raw ids for user rows.
- Security: one finding went to the owner seat as advisory id GHSA-r3cw-542r-c6c3 (doorbell on #31360). Adding the owner seat's account as a collaborator was stopped by this session's permission check and waits on the maintainer.
- Half-states seen on other lanes' cards, reported, not touched: #31488, #31490 and #31496 are closed but still carry `pm:dispatched`.

## Hot-file serial queue

- None: this seat writes no code and opens no PR.

## Notes

- Write path: the relay (`issue-create.mjs`, `post-stamped.mjs`, `close-cards.mjs`, `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`). ⛔ No GitHub MCP writes.
- Runner lessons: one cloud session per 16–23 checklist items, about 40–90 min each; `source_revision` refuses a short sha (start on the default branch and check out the sha first); a scenario runner in Accept-edits mode waits on a permission prompt for every `send_message`, so the maintainer approves it when it reports; a `qa-run` record must list every item on its own line, id first and verdict on the same line, or `retest-owed.mjs` keeps it owed. Runner spend round 1: four checklist sessions about $26 each, the scenario session about $3 plus about $114 API-equivalent on the subscription.
